verified.composed_jump_flight_adapter: src/armageddon/worm-flight.js composes recovered native jump impulse, 50 Hz fixed-point forces/sweep/body tick, and ordinary airborne collision response. visual_media_import.method: Original bytes from the user-provided disc DATA and installed DATA/graphics. Reproducible tools/armageddon/import-visuals.py preserves source paths and SHA-256. Browser decodes SPR/IMG directly and BMP with createImageBitmap. Both compressed and raw SPR layouts are supported. Catalog and integer-scale preview at armageddon.html.
visual_media_import.live: All 29 soil and grass themes tile at native pixel resolution against the existing destructible mask. Original directional sprites replace rocket, mortar and homing projectile models; original grenade, cluster and holy grenade rotation strips replace those models. Original expow and exfoom animations replace procedural impact flashes. Existing original character and equipped-weapon animation integration retained. Original weapon/health/utility crates now use parachute and grounded strips, mines use armed/unarmed art, and barrels/flames use original loops. Dynamite uses the original fuse strip; cluster fragments, airstrike missiles and petrol-bomb projectiles use original frames. Object loops advance through the verified fixed-point NativeAnimationPlayer at 50 Hz with original ping-pong flags and explicit foot anchors. All 29 theme gradient/background strips now replace the procedural backdrop at source resolution. Original water layer/layer.spr tiles horizontally over the fill.img first-pixel colour, with source-sized waves retained when water rises. Theme-specific debris.spr frames replace shrinking coloured squares in explosions and are disposed when particles expire.
visual_media_import.remaining: Imported map pictures remain preview-only; all indexed terrain decoration sprites are now connected to live map generation. Remaining character states, underwater object/worm sprites, custom sticky weapon visuals, smoke and HUD assets still require runtime integration. Background placement, water/debris frame clocks, object event triggers, projectile spin drivers and effect dispatch choices are browser adapters; the full original behavior is not yet ported.

verified.terrain_object_composition_research: Recovered native bitmap blitter 004037F0 from Landgen. All 457 shipped definitions have fields +8=0, +0xc=0, +0x10=1, +0x14=1. The latter reserves the entire placed object rectangle in the 8-pixel occupancy grid (value 3). Constructor 004053E0 also builds a horizontally mirrored copy and flips attachment direction only for 0/1. Weighted selection/16-attempt retry driver is 00409070, using LCG 00407A40. These findings are static evidence; the draw/selection driver has not yet been ported or verified against native execution.
